title: Harden credential copy/reveal: re-auth gate + clipboard hygiene (upstream #2598)
author: robertpopa22
body_snippet:
Tracks the security hardening of the on-demand credential-exposure actions (Copy Password / Type Password / reveal), originally requested upstream in [mRemoteNG/mRemoteNG#2598](https://github.com/mRemoteNG/mRemoteNG/issues/2598).

**Background.** In #2598 @nmg196 argued a copy/export feature isn't a security risk — password managers export to CSV / copy to clipboard, and "it's only a problem if extractable without the master password," suggesting a re-prompt on copy. @Kvarkas (maintainer) is ali...
notes: self-authored tracking issue; cred-reveal hardening shipped 0e7b9c75e, ref upstream #2598
